description: This file defines the EmployeeListener class in the OrangeHRM system, which listens to lifecycle events related to Employee entities, such as preUpdate, postUpdate, and postLoad. It handles encryption and decryption of the SSN number during entity lifecycle events.

classes.name: EmployeeListener
classes.description: Listener class for Employee entity lifecycle events, managing encryption/decryption of sensitive data.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the SSN number if it has changed before updating the Employee entity.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number after the Employee entity has been updated.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number after the Employee entity is loaded from the database.
